visual.name: eclorWaterfall
visual.description: Eclor Waterfall — advanced waterfall chart with dual modes (Cumulative / Comparison), Y-axis floor offset for variation amplification, broken-axis indicator, variation arcs between pillars, and an optional analysis-dimension footnote table aligned with the bars.

en-US.Visual_EmptyPrompt: Select or drag fields to populate this visual
en-US.Visual_DataCapDetail: Showing the first 10,000 rows. Consider applying a filter or drilling down.
en-US.Visual_ErrComparisonPillars: Comparison mode needs at least 2 pillars. Toggle them in the Format pane → Pillars (per category).
en-US.Visual_ErrCumulativePillar: Cumulative mode needs at least one pillar. Either mark a category as pillar (Format → Pillars per category), or enable Format → General → Grand total.

fr-FR.Visual_EmptyPrompt: Sélectionnez ou faites glisser des champs pour alimenter ce visuel
fr-FR.Visual_DataCapDetail: Affichage des 10 000 premières lignes. Appliquez un filtre ou explorez à un niveau inférieur.
fr-FR.Visual_ErrComparisonPillars: Le mode comparaison nécessite au moins 2 piliers. Activez-les dans le volet Format → Piliers (par catégorie).
fr-FR.Visual_ErrCumulativePillar: Le mode cumulatif nécessite au moins un pilier. Marquez une catégorie comme pilier (Format → Piliers par catégorie), ou activez Format → Général → Grand total.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Dimension column whose unique values become the bars of the waterfall.

dataRoles.name: actual
dataRoles.description: Main measure. In Cumulative mode, only the first measure is used. In Comparison mode, drop two measures to auto-build a bridge between them (start = sum of measure 1, end = sum of measure 2, bridges = per-category differences). Field parameters are supported.

dataRoles.name: variance
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more variance measures. Each measure becomes a horizontal rail stacked above the waterfall.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Optional. Additional measures to display in the hover tooltip of each data point.

dataRoles.name: grandTotalLabel
dataRoles.description: Optional. A DAX measure (typically returning text) used to label the synthetic Grand Total bar in cumulative mode. When provided, overrides the static label set in Format → General. The first non-null value across rows is used.

dataRoles.name: legend
dataRoles.description: Optional. A second grouping column (e.g. account type) used to colour bars by group. When set, each unique value is listed in the Format → Legend card with its own fx-enabled ColorPicker, and the global Bridge / Pillar colour slices become inactive. The chart shows a configurable swatches+labels strip honouring the standard PBI Legend options.

dataRoles.name: analysisDim
dataRoles.description: Optional. A dimension to break down each pillar/bridge into one row of values below the waterfall. Renders a table aligned with the bars: one row per unique value, no column headers (the X-axis labels above act as headers). Compatible with Power BI field parameters — drop a parameter column here and the table reshapes accordingly.

yMinOffset.displayName: Y axis floor offset (%) — Comparison only
